# 🪽 FLAPPY WYZUK ### *Next-Generation Indie Neon Arcade Experience* [![Play Online](https://img.shields.io/badge/Play%20Online-flpybrd.netlify.app-00f2fe?style=for-the-badge&logo=netlify&logoColor=white)](https://flpybrd.netlify.app/) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/wyzuk/flappy?style=for-the-badge&color=00f2fe&logo=github)](https://github.com/wyzuk/flappy) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-ff2a7a.svg?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Web%20%7C%20Mobile%20%7C%20Desktop-892cdc.svg?style=for-the-badge)](#) [![Engine](https://img.shields.io/badge/Engine-HTML5%20Canvas%202D-00f090.svg?style=for-the-badge)](#) [![Audio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Audio-Web%20Audio%20API%20Synth-ffbe0b.svg?style=for-the-badge)](#)
**Flappy Wyzuk** is a high-octane, modern indie browser game engineered from scratch with vanilla web technologies. Featuring **glassmorphism aesthetics**, futuristic **neon UI**, 12 customizable bird aviators, 11 dynamic parallax worlds, dynamic weather systems, Web Audio API procedural synthesis, and buttery smooth **60+ FPS** performance. --- [🌐 Play Live Online (flpybrd.netlify.app)](https://flpybrd.netlify.app/) • [✨ Key Features](#-features) • [🕹️ Controls](#-controls) • [🎨 Bird Skins](#-bird-skins) • [🌌 Parallax Worlds](#-worlds--themes) • [🛠️ Architecture](#-project-structure) • [👤 Credits](#-credits) ---

## 📸 Screenshots & Showcase
| Main Landing Screen | In-Flight Parallax HUD | |:---:|:---:| | ![Main Menu Showcase](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1550745165-9bc0b252726f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80) | ![Gameplay Parallax](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511512578047-dfb367046420?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80) | | Character Aviators | Parallax Atmosphere Selection | |:---:|:---:| | ![Bird Selection](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518709268805-4e9042af9f23?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80) | ![World Themes](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534447677768-be436bb09401?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80) |

## ✨ Features - 💎 **Futuristic Glassmorphism & Neon UI**: Translucent blurred glass panels (`backdrop-filter: blur(28px)`), luminous neon glow borders, and floating ambient orbs. - 🪽 **12 Unique Procedural Aviators**: Classic Gold, Cyber Cyan, Crimson Phoenix, Emerald Dragon, Vaporwave Neon, Shadow Stealth, Celestial Angel, Solar Flare, Sakura Blossom, Aurora Frost, Cosmic Void, and Retro 8-Bit. - 🌌 **11 Multi-Layered Parallax Worlds**: Sunny Sky, Sunset Synthwave, Cyber City Night, Enchanted Forest, Alpine Aurora, Deep Ocean, Retro Pixel World, Cosmic Space, Rainy Cyberpunk, Winter Snowstorm, and Golden Desert. - 🌦️ **Dynamic Particle & Weather Systems**: Real-time falling rain streaks, fluffy snowflakes, floating fireflies, water bubble streams, engine flame trails, scoring bursts, impact explosions, and celebratory confetti. - 🎵 **Real-Time Procedural Synthesizer**: Powered 100% by the **Web Audio API**—zero audio file loading latency. Includes frequency-swept jump chirps, harmonic coin chimes, low-pass impact thuds, and dynamic ambient synth pads. - 📈 **Natural Progressive Difficulty Scaling**: Smoothly ramps horizontal speed and pipe clearance without jarring difficulty spikes. - 📱 **Adaptive Cross-Platform Controls**: - **Desktop**: Spacebar, Arrow Up, W key, or Mouse Click. - **Mobile / Touch**: Beautiful floating neon glass jump button with ripple wave animations (automatically hidden on desktop). - 🏆 **Local Storage Persistence**: Automatic high score tracking, total flaps, pipes cleared, games played, and custom settings. - 🚀 **High-DPI Retina Ready**: Sub-pixel canvas rendering supporting 4K monitors and mobile high-density displays at a locked 60+ FPS. --- ## 🕹️ Controls | Platform | Action | Key / Input | |:---|:---|:---| | **Desktop** | Flap / Jump | SPACE or ↑ Arrow or W or Left Click | | **Desktop** | Pause / Resume | ESC or P | | **Desktop** | Quick Mute Audio | M or HUD Audio Button | | **Mobile / Tablet** | Flap / Jump | **Floating Neon Glass Jump Button** | | **Mobile / Tablet** | Tap Screen | Instant Tap to Flap | --- ## 🎨 Bird Skins Each aviator features procedural vector drawing, aerodynamic wing kinematics, eye animation, and customized engine trail sparks: 1. **Classic Gold** – The legendary golden aviator with agile amber wings. 2. **Cyber Cyan** – High-tech mecha bird equipped with neon ion thrusters. 3. **Crimson Phoenix** – Fiery aviator radiating embers and fierce energy. 4. **Emerald Dragon** – Infused with ancient woodland jade scales and horns. 5. **Vaporwave Neon** – Retro 80s synthwave pilot with magenta gradient wings. 6. **Shadow Stealth** – Blacked-out phantom flapper with an infrared ocular sensor. 7. **Celestial Angel** – Blessed with a golden halo and pure pearl feathers. 8. **Solar Flare** – Sunburst orange bird ignited by solar winds. 9. **Sakura Blossom** – Soft pastel pink flyer with floating floral trails. 10. **Aurora Frost** – Glacial cryo-bird crowned with northern light shimmer. 11. **Cosmic Void** – Deep navy flyer harboring dark matter star dust. 12. **Retro 8-Bit** – Blocky chiptune nostalgia straight out of 1989 arcade cabinets. --- ## 🌌 Worlds & Themes Experience multi-layer parallax scrolling with atmospheric physics: - ☀️ **Sunny Sky** – Golden sunlight, puffy clouds, and lush green hills. - 🌆 **Sunset Synthwave** – Wireframe sun with retro blinds and purple horizons. - 🌃 **Cyber City Night** – Neon high-rises, moon glow, and skyscraper silhouettes. - 🌲 **Enchanted Forest** – Ancient mossy canopy with floating bioluminescent fireflies. - 🏔️ **Alpine Aurora** – Wavy emerald northern lights over snow-capped peaks. - 🌊 **Deep Ocean** – Caustic underwater light rays and rising air bubble streams. -
